column1: # Preboot and Recovery layout for an Intel volume group, independent of the macOS build.
# volume<TAB>destination<TAB>source. Sources: tree/PATH (System payload), zip/MEMBER (update asset), out/NAME.
# * in a source stands for a product number. manifest:ROLE:PATTERN takes the file the build's BuildManifest
# names for ROLE (the path matching PATTERN). A destination ending in / is a folder: every match is copied
# there under its own name. Any other destination is one file: its matches must be one file or identical files.
